slot.brief: Given the half-life, find the mean life (or vice versa) of a radionuclide; single relation τ = T½/ln2.

stem: A radionuclide has a half-life of $6.93$ min. Taking $\text{ln}2=0.693$, its mean life is
working:
$\tau=\dfrac{T_{1/2}}{\text{ln}2}=\dfrac{6.93}{0.693}=10.0$ min

Independent check: Mean life $\tau=t_{1/2}/\ln 2=6.93/0.693=10.0$ min.
solution:
Mean life is related to half-life by $\tau=\dfrac{T_{1/2}}{\ln 2}$. Thus,
$$\tau=\dfrac{6.93}{0.693}=10.0\text{ min}.$$
